title: pthread_mutex_init return value unchecked
description:
File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tx_queue.c
Line: 215

pthread_mutex_init() can fail with ENOMEM or EAGAIN on POSIX systems. The return value is ignored and tx_queue_init() returns 0 unconditionally. If initialization fails, subsequent lock_queue()/unlock_queue() calls invoke undefined behavior. Zephyr path (k_mutex_init) is void and cannot fail.
